description: Lunar 🚀 We seek 2 exceptional teammates: • AI & Data: Strong programming, AI/ML, and scientific data analysis skills. • Physics & Space: Excellent knowledge of physics, astronomy, and planetary science. The founder integrates both fields, leads research, sets direction, and manages the team. We expect proven skills, critical thinking, scientific accuracy, commitment, and active teamwork. Our goal: Create an innovative, scientifically sound lunar landing site solution—not just submit a project.
